verdict.rationale: First-party docs show LocalAI acting as an MCP client. It connects AI models to external MCP tools and services, and you select servers per request via `metadata.mcp_servers`. MCP servers can also be attached to individual agents independent of the model, and the built-in agent platform supports MCP tools. missing for 10: concrete docs on how MCP servers are configured (transport types, config format), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the integration works.
